verdict.rationale: Brex documents physical and virtual card issuance on Mastercard with instant/one-click virtual card creation, per-card/employee spend limits and budgets, mobile app management, and bulk issuance via Workato/Pipedream integrations for teams. This directly matches the founder story of quickly issuing cards with individual limits. Missing for 10: independent hands-on timing verification ("minutes") and no first-party case study explicitly confirming founder-level self-service issuance speed.
